🇺🇸 English:

🏡 Available Starting Tomorrow!
Short Term Room for Rent – $800 (Utilities Included) | Bensonhurst, Brooklyn

Hi everyone! I’m renting out my fully furnished room for 1–2 months.

📍 Location: Bensonhurst, Brooklyn — 5 minutes walk to 20th Ave subway station

💰 Rent: $800/month (utilities included)

The room has everything necessary for comfortable living. The apartment is clean and in excellent condition. You’re welcome to come and see the place in person before deciding.

👥 Roommates: very nice, respectful and easy-going people.

💡 Normally the price of the room is $1000/month, but since it’s a short-term rental, I’m offering it for $800.

📅 Move-in: available starting tomorrow.

✅ Requirement: keep the place clean and respectful.

📩 Message me if you’re interested or want to schedule a viewing.
